raw:
@q query
  where all
    match
      relation "negotiate"
      role subject ?p
      role object "the revised data processing addendum"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be the procurement lead"
      role subject ?p
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "leave"
      role subject ?p
      role time ?t
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  where match
    relation "countersign"
    role subject "the vendor"
    role object "the revised data processing addendum"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@a1 assumed
  relation "be in"
  role subject ?t
  role object "June"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature
